## Business Overview
Tailchat is selling a professional communication tool designed for modern teams. The ideal customer is tech-savvy professionals seeking efficient and secure real-time messaging capabilities. Tailchat sits in the market as a niche player offering specialized features like voice readiness, which distinguishes it from broader communication platforms. The brand aims to provide a focused space for professional flow, appealing to those who prioritize productivity and security.
